properties.name: A cube on the equator
properties.shows: One square ring at a height, on a layer with extrude switched on. The ring fills as the lid; every edge of it drops a filled wall to the surface, so what is drawn is a box standing on the ground rather than a square hanging over it.
properties.dimensions: 2° by 2° on the equator is 222.4 km a side, so the top is set at 222,390 m to match it.
properties.note: As near a cube as a sphere allows: the walls run outward from the centre of the Earth rather than parallel, so the top face is 3.5% wider than the footprint it stands on.
properties.why_its_own_layer: Extrude is a per-layer setting, like colour. The geometry tour next door is not extruded, because its airspace shelves are meant to float.
